rationale: F7 (master review 2026-09-30): `hasTypeInference: false` was HARDCODED in real-vue-analyzer.ts, so it said the same thing for every SFC — 778 of the 1,150 restored corpus files carry a lang="ts" block and were all reported as having no type inference, including files whose interface/annotation members the analyzer DOES extract (the TS grammar ran). The field is a statement about what the pipeline did on this file, and the pipeline already computes the fact: `isTs` is true exactly when a block was handed to the TypeScript analyzer. BOTH directions are pinned here, and deliberately: a mutant that flips the constant to `true` unconditionally passes a one-sided pin, which is why js-type-inference pairs with this one.
